name: Mediterranean Undercurrent
scope: Declared southwestern Iberian lower-core reach from the AMUSE launch neighborhood near 8.5 W, 36.5 N, westward around Cape St. Vincent and northward to an OSW western-slope gate at 38.2 N near the Lisbon/Setubal canyon region. Excludes upstream Gibraltar gravity-current descent, offshore Mediterranean Water spreading, meddy looping, Estremadura branch dynamics and uncertain farther-north continuity. Not a full-current axis or float trajectory.
layer: Nonmeddy lower-core Mediterranean Water context, 950–1250 dbar observational selection. Pressure bounds are not converted to uniform depth; vertically separated cores and upstream bottom-trapped density flow remain distinct.
time_convention: AMUSE floats deployed May 1993–March 1994 and tracked for up to 11 months, with May 1993 hydrography and augmented Iberian observations. Selected path is editorial geography, not one dated float trajectory, annual mean or seasonal axis.
source_locator: Introduction [2]–[3], Fig. 1 caption and Data [7]: launch near 36.5 N, 8.5 W and lower-core sampling; Results 3.2 [19]–[22]: west-slope region between St. Vincent Canyon 37 N and Lisbon/Setubal Canyons 38.2 N; Results 3.3 [24]–[25]: branch loss and St. Vincent Spur near 9.5 W.
source_citation: Bower, Serra and Ambar (2002), Structure of the Mediterranean Undercurrent and Mediterranean Water spreading around the southwestern Iberian Peninsula, JGR Oceans 107(C10), doi:10.1029/2001JC001007.
source_license: Publisher free-access article, no open reuse license inferred. Attributed regional facts paraphrased; no figures, float curves or observed fields copied.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects coarse offshore vertices between the published launch neighborhood and latitude-limited western-slope study region. The 38.2 N longitude and cape detour are editorial choices; source does not provide paired whole-current endpoints. St. Vincent Spur geography guides orientation without tracing an isobath, float or meddy loop. Declared alternative detours do not imply seasonal paths.

alternative_routes.interpretation: OSW closer-to-slope geographic detour; requires finer bathymetry and does not represent an observed seasonal route.
OSW farther-offshore approach; not source Mediterranean Water dispersal or a meddy trajectory.

scenario_rule: Three declared regional detours crossed with uniform longitude shifts -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees and independent endpoint latitude shifts -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees: 81 editorial cases, not width, seasonal variation or confidence interval.
remaining_gates: Review launch neighborhood, cape detour and 38.2 N longitude against finer bathymetry and observational support.
Diagnose a depth/time-compatible current axis before physical length or seasonal bounds.
Resolve western-slope branch loss and farther-north continuity before whole-current endpoints.
Keep 30 km one-sided ensemble span and 10 km survey band separate; no seasonal 10–30 km width range or buffered footprint.
